# Copyright (c) 2020 Nordic Semiconductor ASA
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

config NET_WIREGUARD
	bool "WireGuard support"
	depends on NET_L2_RAW_PKT
	depends on NET_IPV6 || NET_IPV4
	select NET_PKT_RX_HANDLER_ARGS
	select NET_PKT_TX_HANDLER_ARGS
	select NET_UDP
	select NET_CONN_MANAGER
	select NET_STATISTICS
	select NET_STATISTICS_IPV6 if NET_IPV6
	select NET_STATISTICS_IPV4 if NET_IPV4
	select NET_STATISTICS_UDP
	select NET_STATISTICS_WIREGUARD
	select NET_VPN
	help
	  Enable support for WireGuard VPN.

if NET_WIREGUARD

config NET_WIREGUARD_MAX_PEERS
	int "Maximum number of WireGuard peers"
	default 1
	range 1 10
	help
	  Maximum number of WireGuard peers that can be configured.

config NET_WIREGUARD_MAX_INTERFACES
	int "Maximum number of WireGuard interfaces"
	default 1
	range 1 4
	help
	  Maximum number of WireGuard interfaces that can be configured.

config NET_WIREGUARD_PEER_TIMEOUT
	int "WireGuard peer timeout (seconds)"
	default 180
	help
	  Timeout for WireGuard peers. If no traffic is received from a peer
	  within this time, the peer is considered inactive and its state
	  is reset.

config NET_WIREGUARD_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL
	int "WireGuard keepalive interval (seconds)"
	default 10
	help
	  Interval for sending keepalive packets to WireGuard peers.
	  Set to 0 to disable keepalives.

config NET_WIREGUARD_LOG_LEVEL_DBG
	bool "Enable WireGuard debug logging"
	depends on LOG
	help
	  Enable verbose debug logging for WireGuard.

endif # NET_WIREGUARD
